title: Use Seedance to rapidly test VFX ideas/concepts, then rebuild and refine the…
content:
Use Seedance to rapidly test VFX ideas/concepts, then rebuild and refine the chosen results by hand in your traditional workflow.
Combine Seedance with DaVinci Resolve to iterate on and test music video VFX effects quickly.
tips:
Use Seedance to rapidly test VFX ideas/concepts, then rebuild and refine the chosen results by hand in your traditional workflow.
Combine Seedance with DaVinci Resolve to iterate on and test music video VFX effects quickly.

es.content:
Utiliza Seedance para probar rápidamente ideas/conceptos de VFX, luego reconstruye y refina los resultados elegidos manualmente en tu flujo de trabajo tradicional.  
Combina Seedance con DaVinci Resolve para iterar y probar efectos de VFX en videos musicales de manera rápida.

fr.content: Utilisez Seedance pour tester rapidement des idées/concepts de VFX, puis reconstruisez et affinez les résultats choisis à la main dans votre flux de travail traditionnel. Combinez Seedance avec DaVinci Resolve pour itérer et tester rapidement les effets VFX de vidéoclips musicaux.

ja.content:
---
Seedanceを使用してVFXのアイデアやコンセプトを迅速にテストし、選ばれた結果を従来のワークフローで手作業で再構築し、洗練させます。
SeedanceをDaVinci Resolveと組み合わせて、ミュージックビデオのVFX効果を迅速に反復し、テストします。
---

ko.content:
Seedance를 사용하여 VFX 아이디어/컨셉을 빠르게 테스트한 후, 전통적인 워크플로우에서 선택된 결과를 수작업으로 재구성하고 정제하세요.  
Seedance와 DaVinci Resolve를 결합하여 뮤직 비디오 VFX 효과를 빠르게 반복하고 테스트하세요.

pt.content:
Use o Seedance para testar rapidamente ideias/conceitos de VFX e, em seguida, reconstruir e refinar os resultados escolhidos manualmente no seu fluxo de trabalho tradicional.  
Combine o Seedance com o DaVinci Resolve para iterar e testar rapidamente efeitos de VFX em videoclipes musicais.

zh.content:
使用Seedance快速测试VFX创意/概念，然后在传统工作流程中手动重建和完善选定的结果。  
将Seedance与DaVinci Resolve结合使用，以快速迭代和测试音乐视频的VFX效果。
